name: 1.22.0-beta.26
notes: Find variants by hand has a tidier panel: what is being compared stays at the top (with arrows to go to the previous or next version), with a line saying how much differs. Below it, tabs: Choose (choosing what goes into a layer, and the brush or colour tool settings), New layer, Layers, View (what to show and how different a point must be) and Base. The tools stay at the bottom, and the tab content scrolls on its own.
